Priya N.: Quick sync — engineering flagged QA backlog + embeddings infra tests. If we keep current scope we miss the launch SLO.
Alex M.: What's the minimal slice? Suggest: core chat, auth, telemetry. Anything non-blocking we can move.
Marco: ```- cut: promptstore UI (post-launch)
- cut: tenant SSO optional (v1)
- cut: embeddings dedup optimization (v1)
- keep: model pinning, canary route, cost telemetry```
Jin: Customer pilot (ACME) depends on SSO. If we drop SSO we lose pilot -> they'd delay. Are we ok to accept delayed pilot?
Priya N.: Recommend: keep tenant SSO for enterprise plan only (opt-in), move promptstore to v1. That keeps pilot alive and reduces scope.
Samir: Engineering accepts opt-in SSO + enterprise opt-in flag. We'll need an extra day for smoke tests. Can we slip launch by 24h instead of full reset?
Alex M.: Approve 24h slip + opt-in SSO. Action items: Priya assign tasks, Marco update release notes, Samir schedule smoke window.
deploy-bot: Canary window reserved 2024-06-14 09:00-12:00 UTC. @channel
Priya N.: :thumbsup: I'll update milestone tracker and notify ACME. Moving promptstore -> v1. I'll post final cutlist in the tracker.
